svg.title: Do not confuse a proxy with the target
svg.desc: Do not confuse a proxy with the target | A proxy is a related measurement, not the thing we ultimately want to know. | GEOAI FIELD GUIDE / Original teaching schematic — not observed health data | AIR QUALITY | Satellite aerosol signal | ≠ | Ground-level exposure | Add monitors, atmospheric modeling and time alignment. | WATER QUALITY | Visible color / turbidity | ≠ | Microbial or chemical safety | Add samples, validated retrievals and supply-system context. | Remote sensing provides evidence about a proxy; validate the health-relevant quantity.
svg.text: Do not confuse a proxy with the target
A proxy is a related measurement, not the thing we ultimately want to know.
